ENERGY_HERO_TEMPLATES.deficient: 你以{dominant}为主导，但内心深处却隐隐缺乏{deficient}。

TIMELINE_HERO: 你最辉煌的十年大约从{best_age}岁（{best_pillar}）开始。你最艰难的十年大约从{worst_age}岁开始。

TIMELINE_GRADE_BLURB.PEAK: 难得的契机。请审慎把握。
TIMELINE_GRADE_BLURB.NEUTRAL: 效果参差不齐。请关注哪些方法确实有效。
TIMELINE_GRADE_BLURB.CAUTION: 淡季。优先保证休息并划清界限。
TIMELINE_GRADE_BLURB.CHALLENGING: 艰难时期。若能顺利度过，你就会成长。

LUCKY_CODE_HERO_TEMPLATE: 你的力量元素是 {element} —— 充分发挥它的力量吧。

HEALTH_HERO_TEMPLATES.missing: {dominant} 占主导地位——你几乎没有任何 {missing}。

CHART_POSITION_TEMPLATES.year_pillar: 在你的起源中，{archetype}塑造了你最初接触世界的方式。
CHART_POSITION_TEMPLATES.month_pillar: 在你的公共工作中，{archetype} 就是你展现自我的方式。
CHART_POSITION_TEMPLATES.day_pillar: {archetype} 是你的核心——这就是真正的你。
CHART_POSITION_TEMPLATES.hour_pillar: 在你的遗产中，{archetype} 将决定你留给后人的东西。

CHART_NOTE_TEMPLATE: 你的{a}和{b}拥有相同的“{archetype}”能量。这意味着它们密不可分——你的公众形象与你的本质合二为一。
DISCLAIMER: 注：本报告将天文计算与现代教练理论框架相结合，旨在提供个人洞见和娱乐价值。本报告不构成医疗、财务或心理建议。传统的“四柱命理”分析因流派而异——不同流派对同一命盘可能得出不同的结论，正如不同的治疗师对同一个人也会有不同的描述。 请将此报告视为一种发人深省的解读，而非定论。您的决定仍由您自己做主。如果您正处于危机之中，请联系当地紧急服务部门或自杀预防热线。如果您身处美国境外，请访问 https://findahelpline.com/。

THE_STEWARD.headline: 你进展缓慢——而这正是你的优势。
THE_STEWARD.body:
与其冒险走捷径，你更愿意用心呵护某件事。对你而言，资源——时间、关注、人际关系——只要耐心管理，其价值便会倍增。

你珍视那些经得起时间考验的事物。当别人在追逐下一个闪亮的新事物时，你却默默地巩固着已有的成果。这是一种难得的自律。

风险在于，“谨慎”可能会变成一种关闭机会之门的习惯。过于保守地行事同样要付出代价。
THE_STEWARD.action: 选一件你已经拥有的东西，问问自己：它是否仍在为我服务，还是我只是出于习惯才一直保留着它？
patterns: Your cash and savings allocation is very high.
Fear of loss makes you delay decisions.
You believe in compounding and prefer long holds.
THE_STEWARD.best_reason: A partner who adds returns on top of your safe base.
THE_STEWARD.challenging_reason: If both of you only play it safe, your assets lose to inflation.
actions: Diversify 10% of your assets into an index fund.
Once a year, compare your savings rate against inflation.
Start automatic dollar-cost averaging.
red_flags: Is everything you own locked in savings accounts?
Have you lent money to friends and never got it back?

THE_OPERATOR.headline: 你将资源视为需要流动的能量。
THE_OPERATOR.body:
当别人只看到杂音时，你却能发现机遇。你对交流——无论是思想、关注还是资源的交流——有着敏锐的直觉。

你很少满足于让事情停滞不前。你享受构建、连接和推动事物向前发展的动态能量。

但当一切都飞速流动时，漏洞可能与溪流一样大。让你保持平衡的不是速度——而是你真正全身心投入的少数几件事。
THE_OPERATOR.action: 这周，留意你的能量流向何处，又从何处流失。不是为了去解决它——只是为了观察它。
patterns: You try to build multiple income sources.
You take risks but spread them out.
Spending rises as fast as income does.
THE_OPERATOR.best_reason: A partner who anchors the assets you scatter.
THE_OPERATOR.challenging_reason: If both of you love risk, recovery in a crisis is hard.
actions: Lock 30% of income into automatic savings.
Impose a 3-day cooling-off period before any new investment.
Use a debit card instead of credit to control spending.
red_flags: Is income high but nothing ever stays in the account?
Are you borrowing to invest?

THE_FLOW.headline: 你与资源的关系会随着你的人生而变化。
THE_FLOW.body:
你对金钱没有固定的态度。当你的生活步入正轨时，资源往往会主动找上门；反之，无论付出多少努力，似乎都收效甚微。

你对“什么最重要”的判断是凭直觉的，而非循规蹈矩。比起任何既定的计划，你更在意今天自己的注意力集中在哪里。

其中的风险在于，这种灵活性可能会沦为逃避承诺的借口。哪怕只有一个稳定的习惯，也能为其他习惯奠定基础。
THE_FLOW.action: 请写下你本月的三项最大开支。它们是否反映了你目前的状况？
patterns: Your income and spending swing widely.
Wealth opportunities arrive through people.
You spend as you go rather than budgeting.
THE_FLOW.best_reason: Someone who keeps you centered so your life has fewer swings.
THE_FLOW.challenging_reason: Two improvisers is a fast road to ruin.
actions: Split into two accounts (emergency / living).
Wait 24 hours before any large purchase.
Save 10% of every month's income, unconditionally.
red_flags: Are you juggling credit-card debt from month to month?
Have you been talked into an investment by a friend and lost money?

THE_CREATOR.headline: 当你能在工作中看到自己留下的印记时，你就会如鱼得水。
THE_CREATOR.body:
你对毫无意义的琐事过敏。你需要从零开始创造一些东西，或者在其中注入你独特的见解。

你的脑海中总是翻涌着各种想法。当你将这些想法付诸实践并激励他人时，你会感到最大的成就感。在能够自由发挥创造力的自主环境中，你才能真正大放异彩。

但你也必须接受作为创作者的痛苦。当灵感枯竭或作品被低估时，你会很容易受到伤害。学会不执着于结果，而享受过程本身。
THE_CREATOR.action: 本周请预留90分钟，专心进行创作，绝不被任何事情打断。
patterns: Autonomy matters more to you than rules.
You have the execution muscle to make ideas real.
You react sharply to criticism.
THE_CREATOR.best_reason: Someone who can systemize and champion your creativity.
THE_CREATOR.challenging_reason: You clash head-on with bosses who demand only compliance.
actions: Carve out 5 hours a week of deep creative focus.
Ship output at 80% instead of 100%.
Reframe criticism as feedback, not attack.
red_flags: Is perfectionism making you miss deadlines?
Are you ignoring every instruction from a boss?

THE_CHALLENGER.headline: 当事情出了问题、需要修复时，你才能发挥出最佳状态。
THE_CHALLENGER.body:
你不需要一个完美的系统，你需要一个真实的问题。你能比任何人都更早发现哪里出了问题。

你是一位厌恶现状的创新者。你会问“为什么我们要这样做？”，并寻找更好的方法。在危机中，你会成为真正的领导者。

但如果批评成了习惯，人们可能会认为你消极。不要只是指出问题，还要提出解决方案和替代方案。
THE_CHALLENGER.action: 向真正有能力改变现状的人，坦率地倾诉一件让你默默感到沮丧的事情。
patterns: You can't let inefficiency slide.
You rise into leadership during crises.
You're unafraid to challenge authority.
THE_CHALLENGER.best_reason: Someone who can turn your ideas into products or systems.
THE_CHALLENGER.challenging_reason: You collide with people who insist on the rules.
actions: Always pair complaints with alternatives.
Learn to save face for the boss in conversations.
Practice listening to a colleague all the way through.
red_flags: Are you opposing for the sake of opposing?
Is your presence making teammates shrink?

THE_OFFICER.headline: 只有在值得信赖的框架内，你才能发挥出最佳水平。
THE_OFFICER.body:
你需要的是合情合理的规则。在合适的团队里，你是中流砥柱；在不合适的团队里，你只会筋疲力尽。

你重视原则和公平。你有能力建立并维护让他人能够安全工作的体系。你凭借强烈的责任感和可靠性赢得了信任。

但过于拘泥于规则可能会让你显得缺乏灵活性。请记住，有时人比流程更重要。
THE_OFFICER.action: 请写下三项你认为工作应体现的价值观。你目前所在的工作环境是否与这些价值观一致？
patterns: You finish what you're given, no matter what.
You value hierarchy and clear reporting lines.
You're excellent at pre-empting risk.
THE_OFFICER.best_reason: Innovators who add change on top of your stable foundation.
THE_OFFICER.challenging_reason: You clash with people who constantly break the rules.
actions: Learn a new tool and automate part of your workflow.
When a directive is unfair, persuade with data.
Practice welcoming ideas from younger colleagues.
red_flags: Do you say 'we've always done it this way' too often?
Are you falling behind by resisting change?

THE_SURVIVOR.headline: 压力能让人成长，但这种压力必须有其意义。
THE_SURVIVOR.body:
你对辛勤工作有着极高的承受力，但你知道何时代价过高。你曾果断放弃那些足以击垮他人的事情。

面对危机时，你会本能地进入生存模式。当别人说“不可能”时，你却仍有突破的能量。你将逆境转化为成长的阶梯。

但你的坚韧在旁人眼中可能显得冷酷或无情。别忘了，展现脆弱也是一种真正的力量。
THE_SURVIVOR.action: 回想一下，上一次你为了自己而放弃赶截止日期的时候。回想一下，你当时为什么这么做。
patterns: You stay calm under crisis.
Your obsession with the goal is intense.
You're clumsy with emotional expression.
THE_SURVIVOR.challenging_reason: Two aggressives and the team gets scorched.
actions: Set one full day off each week.
Approach a colleague first with thanks.
Use exercise or a hobby to discharge stress.
red_flags: Are you running through burnout signals?
Are teammates afraid of you?

THE_MYSTIC.headline: 你会跳出框框思考，这就是你的超能力。
THE_MYSTIC.body:
你能发现别人忽略的关联。你的最佳作品往往走的是迂回曲折的道路。当它最终呈现时，总能带来与众不同的效果。

你的直觉和洞察力非同寻常。你能洞见表象背后的本质。深度专注的工作——研究、分析、战略制定——正是你所擅长的领域。

但思考过于深入可能会延误行动。在完美的蓝图形成之前就行动起来吧。前路会在你前行的过程中逐渐展开。
THE_MYSTIC.action: 本周给自己留出一小时，不要安排任何计划。顺着任何吸引你的线索走，无需设定目标。
patterns: You analyze heavily before acting.
Your intuitive insight is outstanding.
Surface-level work bores you.
THE_MYSTIC.best_reason: Executors who turn your analysis into action.
THE_MYSTIC.challenging_reason: You can't connect with people who skim the surface.
actions: Force yourself to take the first step within 3 days of analysis.
Visualize and share your analysis with the team.
Find a partner with strong execution.
red_flags: Are you analyzing while opportunities slip by?
Are you too deep inside your own head?

THE_MENTOR.headline: 当你帮助他人成长时，你也会因此而茁壮成长。
THE_MENTOR.body:
你不仅希望自己做得出色，更希望帮助他人变得出色。你最杰出的贡献往往是无形的，发生在他人内心深处。

你天生擅长分享知识和经验。你能发现后辈或同行的潜力，并悉心培养，助其茁壮成长。

但帮助他人成长可能会让你忽视自身的成长。展现出你自己仍在学习和成长，这将给他人带来更大的鼓舞。
THE_MENTOR.action: 联系一位你曾帮助过的人，告诉他你在他身上看到了怎样的潜力。
patterns: You listen well to juniors' struggles.
You love sharing what you know.
You tend to put your own results last.
THE_MENTOR.best_reason: People who take your warm advice and pay it back with results.
THE_MENTOR.challenging_reason: Lone-wolf styles may not mesh with yours.
actions: Define your own career goals clearly.
Build expertise of your own beyond mentoring.
Show juniors that you're still learning from them.
red_flags: Are you caring for juniors while your own review sinks?
Are you resting on teaching alone?

THE_GENERALIST.headline: 你就是那种样样都懂一点的人。
THE_GENERALIST.body:
你并非某个领域的专家，而这恰恰是你的优势。你能将不同领域的项目有机地串联起来。正是在这些衔接之处，才最需要你。

与深入钻研一件事相比，你更倾向于积累广泛的经验。实际上，你正是那种能够连接不同领域、创造新价值的“T型”人才。

或许有人会说你缺乏深度。但要想让你的广度真正成为优势，你需要打造至少一项“尖端专长”——一个无人能及的领域。
THE_GENERALIST.action: 选出两项你通常分开使用的技能，然后找一个需要同时运用这两项技能的项目。
patterns: You're curious and love learning.
You adapt roles fluidly to the moment.
Your focus sometimes scatters.
THE_GENERALIST.best_reason: People who integrate your varied ideas into one strategy.
THE_GENERALIST.challenging_reason: People who insist on one rule frustrate you.
actions: Pick the single expertise you'll concentrate on this year.
Use your broad network to create collaboration opportunities.
Turn your experience into content.
red_flags: Are you starting a lot and finishing nothing?
Are you actually working to become an expert at something?

THE_TWIN.headline: 你们是通过平等的伙伴建立联系，而不是通过观众。
THE_TWIN.body:
你不需要领导者，也不需要追随者；你需要的是一个与你并肩前行、朝着同一方向走去的伙伴。你不需要被需要——你需要的是被理解。

你与他人保持平等的相处方式。你珍视那种既能承认彼此差异，又能共同成长的关系。

但若只追求“酷”的关系，反而会阻碍深层亲密感的建立。要真正拉近距离，你们需要学会偶尔互相依靠。
THE_TWIN.action: 给一个与你旗鼓相当的人发条消息吧。不是为了索取什么，只是为了建立联系。
patterns: You prefer friend-level comfort over romance.
You respect each other's private space.
You dislike power struggles.
THE_TWIN.best_reason: Someone who respects your autonomy and approaches softly.
THE_TWIN.challenging_reason: Two cool types can make the relationship stale.
actions: Sometimes be the first to reach out.
Speak up honestly when something is off.
Create one shared hobby.
red_flags: Are you so detached that your partner feels hurt?
Are you hiding feelings to avoid conflict?

THE_RIVAL.headline: 你们之间的纽带，既源于摩擦，也源于温暖。
THE_RIVAL.body:
你需要那些敢于提出异议的人。你最棒的人际关系中总带着一丝竞争的火花，而这正是维系这些关系的关键。

你从与持不同意见的人交谈中获得灵感。你享受那种能够互相提出犀利反馈、彼此磨砺的关系。

但并非每一次对话都必须变成争论。你需要具备同理心，去理解对方此刻是需要安慰还是建议。
THE_RIVAL.action: 联系一位与你之间曾有过良性摩擦的人，并请他/她坦率地表达真实看法。
patterns: You don't fear disagreement.
Your humor and competitive streak run deep.
You argue with logic more than emotion.
THE_RIVAL.best_reason: People who soften your edge and arbitrate gently.
THE_RIVAL.challenging_reason: If both want to win, the relationship breaks.
actions: Check the other person's feelings mid-debate.
Compliment your partner once a day.
Practice listening without countering.
red_flags: Are you saying hurtful things to win?
Are you arguing logic while your partner is exhausted?

THE_ALLY.headline: 你们因忠诚和共同的价值观而紧密相连。
THE_ALLY.body:
你不会随意结交人。你会慎重选择，一旦选择便始终如一。你的忠诚虽不张扬，却毋庸置疑。

你非常重视忠诚。当朋友或家人遇到困难时，你总是第一个赶去帮忙的人。你的坚定让许多人信任并依赖你。

但你的忠诚有时也会成为对方的负担。放下那种非要为他们解决一切问题的执念，看着他们独立站稳脚跟，这也是一种爱。
THE_ALLY.action: 主动联系一下你一直想找的人。不是因为你必须这么做，而是因为你想这么做。
patterns: You place enormous value on loyalty.
You can't look away when a friend is in trouble.
You're endlessly generous to your inner circle.
THE_ALLY.best_reason: People who treasure your steady support and grow with it.
THE_ALLY.challenging_reason: People who exploit your loyalty hurt you.
actions: Drop the compulsion to solve everything yourself.
Help only when asked.
Cut relationships that drain you.
red_flags: Is your life falling apart because you're upholding loyalty?
Are you being used by takers?

THE_EMPATH.headline: 通过感同身受，你们之间便建立了情感纽带。
THE_EMPATH.body:
你善于快速而准确地洞察他人。在对方自己察觉之前，你就能发现他们状态不对劲。这让你成为一位难得的朋友——但请务必保护好自己的精力。

你拥有深厚的同理心，能将他人的痛苦视作自己的痛苦。人们之所以聚集在你身边，是因为你无需他们开口，就能理解他们的心声。

但过度共情意味着你常常忽视自己的感受，从而感到精疲力竭。你必须学会设定健康的心理界限。
THE_EMPATH.action: 本周请至少自问一次：“这种情绪是我的，还是我背负了别人的？”
patterns: You read facial shifts well.
You're excellent at empathy and comfort.
You try to carry everyone's feelings alone.
THE_EMPATH.best_reason: People who stay grounded and don't get swept up in your emotions.
actions: Ask yourself once a day how you feel first.
Don't resolve others' emotions for them.
Protect enough alone time.
red_flags: Are you drowning in others' sadness?
Are you postponing your own feelings?
